tool_input.description: Probe Fraction behavior for tricky inputs

result: Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/math/FractionAgentTest.java` with 73 self-contained JUnit 5 tests covering `Fraction`'s factory methods, arithmetic operations, comparisons, conversions, string formatting, and overflow/boundary/error cases (zero denominators, `Integer.MIN_VALUE` edge cases, null arguments, malformed strings). All tests pass via `./_tools/test.sh`, and the full suite (including the pre-existing `FractionReadObjectTest`) still passes.
